tests.name: [tools] public Pi routes preserve read/edit/write/grep/find/ls schemas, results and final native effects
[final-input] a later mutable hook is checked at the final consumer and cannot reuse harmless inputs
[user-bash] ! and !! return handled operations with native output and denial, never host fallback
[user-bash] installed Pi session consumer records ! and !! with the guarded operations
[tools] TUI/RPC approvals cover one complete edit action and print/JSON deny absent UI
[tools] approved outside write covers its mkdir helper without widening sibling permissions
[startup] public guarded startup rejects discarded factories, missing backend and unknown tools
[nested] actual built-in codemode calls reach guarded local tools and retain structured bash results
[options] supplied bash prefix, spawn cwd/env, seconds, signal and streaming reach the final consumer
[tools] the host file queue waits for a cancelled worker to settle before admitting another mutation

toolRoutes.bash: host Pi formatting and operations -> bound admission -> native shell worker
toolRoutes.files: host Pi schemas/renderers -> bound admission -> public Pi definitions inside native worker
toolRoutes.codemode: public built-in QuickJS -> ctx.executeTool -> same final wrappers
toolRoutes.userBash: always handled operations; final prefix/cwd/env/options rechecked
toolRoutes.reload: readiness barrier prevents discarded extension fallback

trustBoundaries: Pi and explicitly trusted extensions are controllers
remote MCP internals and arbitrary trusted in-process effects are outside native workload confinement
unknown tools require explicit trusted adapters
